items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Wave flip (3a-3f), per-unit worktree wiring, brief params, wave-scoped sentinel, restore_derived_to_head concurrency test, launch-failure/no-result reconciliation all delivered per R5a-wave-build-flip.md.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: campaign_wave.py handles a missing/empty loop_unit by falling back to resolve_run_id; no new unhandled boundary introduced.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Sentinel used only for truthiness (authorship guard); never treated as an identity value anywhere in the migrated consumers; no secrets, no raw input handling changed.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: New tests assert outcomes (state transitions, sentinel-safe fallback, cross-worktree isolation), including failure-path coverage (launch failure, running-no-result, max-attempts exhausted).

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Orchestration prose + small pure-Python helpers; no query/loop/async surface touched.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: campaign_wave.py (91 LOC) new, well under 300; _run_id.py held at exactly 300; sub-iterate-runner.md held at its existing 512 exception ceiling; campaign-mode.md's 810->983 growth filed as its own bloat-exception ADR.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: loop_state.json / result.json (producer: loop_claim/autonomous_loop + sub-iterate-runner Step 6; consumer: campaign-mode.md 3e/3f) and derived-snapshot files under concurrent worktrees are the two changed boundaries; both have real round-trip/integration probes (test_wave_launch_failure_and_reconcile.py, test_derived_snapshots_wave_concurrency.py) using actual git worktrees and on-disk state files, not mocks.
